data.action: 单膝蹲在天台边缘，手搭凉棚远眺龙门都市
data.description: 【能天使 · 天台速递】狂风呼啸的龙门摩天大楼天台边缘，能天使单膝蹲在护栏顶端，单手搭成凉棚极目远眺下方穿梭如织的车流，身后的八支高阶铳械与金色光翼在夕阳下熠熠生辉——「目标坐标已锁定！准备好来一场突破重力极限的屋顶空中大漂移了吗？抓紧我的腰，我们出发！」
data.promptProse: Exusiai crouches on one knee atop a Lungmen rooftop guardrail, shading her eyes to inspect traffic far below. Her city-rider outfit, eight guns and golden light wings hold their silhouette against the orange dusk sky. A medium-wide view shows the roof edge beneath her and streets converging among distant towers. Sunset lights the wing edges and rail top, leaving building faces below in deeper shade.
data.title: 能天使 · 天台速递
